answer: Stop sybils with a rotating voice-liveness challenge: one voice, one identity. First, a new agent speaks a random phrase live, and its voice embedding is registered like a willow bent into a unique shape. Second, the network re-challenges the voice every 30 days, so a recorded clip dies fast. Third, a mismatched voice burns a 250 POA bond and locks the identity for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 voice actors at $40 each, $400,000, plus 2,500,000 POA in bonds. Like an ember that only glows when truly lit, a real voice warms the oasis of trust while clones stay cold.
